>>253320261
>What did he mean by "masochistic tendencies"?

....don't really see any further need for clarification on what Ted meant in that paragraph. He is very clear about what he means, as usual:

20. Notice the masochistic tendency of leftist tactics. Leftists protest by lying down in front of vehicles, they intentionally provoke police or racists to abuse them, etc. These tactics may often be effective, but many leftists use them not as a means to an end but because they PREFER masochistic tactics. Self-hatred is a leftist trait.

------

Read that paragraph carefully, without rushing thru or glossing over it; his meaning comes across clearly enough. 

In any case, just to shoot the shit a little regarding this topic: these Leftists seem to believe that by portraying themselves as 'suffering', they might get their agenda or whatever across more efficiently than other groups. And to a certain extent they seem to be right; they appeal to the feels, and the feels always respond and inform all subsequent action. 

i.e:

One thing is informing you with cold hard facts about the inherent cruelty and callousness of whale-hunting. Another very different thing is to show you a highly curated/edited video where Greenpeace 'rebels' and 'activists' risk muh lives against the activity of whaling by attacking a huge vessel with their destined-to-lose tactics. They seem to always be ready to draw a tear from your eye. 

THAT is masochism, in the service of whavever ridiculous, petty and bombastic system-appeasing ideas they happen to be concerned with at any given point in time.
